hpssd_enabled.description: Enable the HP Status Service daemon (hpssd) for real-time device status monitoring.

auto_discovery_enabled.description: Automatically detect HP devices (printers, scanners, faxes) on the local network.

discovery_timeout.description: Time (in seconds) to wait before timing out a device discovery attempt.

network_scan_enabled.description: Enable scanning over the network for HP network-enabled scanners/faxes.

fax_enabled.description: Enable fax support (requires a physical fax/modem device or IP fax service).

printer_auto_install_enabled.description: Automatically install supported HP printers when detected.

hpcups_dir.description: Path to directory containing HP CUPS drivers (preferred for newer devices).

hpijs_dir.description: Path to directory containing legacy hpijs drivers (for older devices).

plugin_path.description: Path where proprietary HP plugin modules are stored (e.g., firmware, advanced features).

plugin_download_enabled.description: Allow automatic download of required proprietary plugins from HP servers.

allowed_usb_ids.description: List of USB vendor:product IDs allowed for device communication (format: vendor_id:product_id).

items.description: USB vendor:product ID pair (e.g., 03f0:4211 for HP LaserJet Pro MFP M127w).

blacklisted_devices.description: List of devices (vendor:product) to explicitly exclude from auto-configuration.

items.description: Device vendor:product ID pair (e.g., 03f0:0000) to block.

device_timeout.description: Maximum time (in seconds) to wait for a response from a device before aborting.

refresh_interval.description: Interval (in minutes) between automatic device list refreshes.

refresh_enabled.description: Enable periodic refresh of detected device list.

default_scan_resolution.description: Default scan resolution in DPI for new scan jobs (common values: 150, 300, 600).

default_scan_color_mode.description: Default scan color mode (options: color, gray, lineart).

advanced_scan_features_enabled.description: Enable advanced features like TWAIN support, document feeding, and batch scanning.

fax_sender_name.description: Default sender name used in fax headers.

fax_sender_fax_number.description: Default sender fax number (optional, may be overridden per job).

ip_fax_enabled.description: Enable sending faxes over IP/T.38 (requires network fax service support).

default_print_quality.description: Default print quality (options: draft, normal, best).

default_paper_size.description: Default paper size (options: a4, letter, legal, executive, etc.).

duplex_enabled.description: Enable two-sided (duplex) printing by default, if supported by the device.
